name: Product Launch Announcement
description: Announce a new product or feature to your audience.
html_content:
Introducing our newest release

Hi {first_name},

We've been working on something special, and today we're excited to share it with you.

What's new

  • A faster, simpler way to get started
  • Smarter automation that saves you hours
  • A redesigned dashboard you'll actually enjoy using

Be among the first to try it — no setup needed, no extra fee for existing customers.

Try it now from your dashboard, or reply to this email if you'd like a quick walkthrough.

Thanks for being part of this journey.

— The {company_name} Team
